brief:
Israeli settlers have redirected water sources from Fasayil village in the occupied West Bank, converting springs formerly used for agricultural irrigation and Palestinian consumption into a swimming pool, Shehab Wire reported. The diversion represents a shift in tactics, moving control over water into new territory as a tool of displacement.

Water confiscation has intensified across the occupied West Bank. Springs that once irrigated Palestinian farmland and supplied drinking water to residents now serve settler facilities instead. The takeover of Fasayil's water sources exemplifies a wider pattern: Israeli authorities and settlers seizing Palestinian water infrastructure systematically, leaving communities dependent on limited supplies while settlers expand access to the resource.

title: Israeli settlers divert Palestinian village water to swimming pool
